title: Protected read-only pptx 001
notes: the only real modify-protection knob in presentationML is CT_Presentation/modifyVerifier (PowerPoint's legacy 'modify password' element) — injected via zip rewrite at its schema position, after defaultTextStyle, as <p:modifyVerifier covered="1"/> with NO password/salt/spinCount/cryptAlgorithm attributes: a password-less modify-reminder flag, not a real protection hash. There is no clean package-level read-only-recommended flag a generator can set (docProps appMetadata is not writable here; <p15:persistence> is a co-authoring marker, not protection), so this is the honest closest feature — legacy modifyVerifier; modern PowerPoint may ignore it and LibreOffice likely does. Body text is plain python-pptx content and is the whole reference_text.
